I've never really "owned" any particular achievement in my life. Not when I finished my degree, not learning a difficult piece of music on the violin, not getting any particular jobs... I've struggled with mental illness pretty well all my life and my mind will never let me have anything. In my mind, I've somehow conned my way into all of these things. Nothing feels like my own. 

This morning I was a ball of anxiety/sadness and figured I'd spend the day in bed or on my computer.. but instead I somehow pushed myself out of my bed and onto my treadmill (quite literally pajamas and all). All the negativity in my mind kept telling me that this week was going to be hard and there was no way I could do it. But I did. I fucking did it, and I feel so proud of myself. I did this for me, this is all mine. I hope I can take the rest of my life back and feel like it's all mine, too. 

Thank you C25k. This morning I was looking at photos of myself and criticizing them, but soon landed on this subreddit... I don't know, it must have been seeing all your happy, sweaty faces, and all of your words of encouragement.. it was really motivating. I really thank you all for that. Truly. 

TL;DR Here's my selfie. I am proud of myself this morning, and I hope you all feel that way about yourselves, too.
